Laura / Sara — attaching the first-pass technical artifacts. Highlights:

- data-flow-diagram-v1.pdf: shows ingress (API/Console), transient KV-cache on GPU nodes, persistent object store for model artifacts and logs (S3), and a separate encrypted metrics store for operational telemetry. Diagram annotates where PHI/PII may be present (customer-provided prompts).
- subprocessors-list.csv: current list (cloud provider, observability vendor, hosted key manager). We mark which subprocessor processes customer content vs telemetry.

Notes on retention and controls:
- Customer content: by default retained for 30 days in our hosted product unless customer requests retention changes via contract. For Dedicated/Private customers retention is configurable; for Caldera we will follow contract clause #6 (if present).
- KV cache: ephemeral, zero-backup; not persisted beyond configured cache TTL (default 10 minutes).
- Audit logs: retained in an immutable log store for 90 days by default; extended retention options available under enterprise contract.
- Encryption: data at rest encrypted with AES-256; KMS-managed keys with customer-controlled key option for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Access: role-based access control (RBAC) with privileged access auditing; support ticket required for raw data exports.

Attachments: data-flow-diagram-v1.pdf (diagram), subprocessors-list.csv (CSV).

—Aditya
Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted): scope covers logical access, change management, and backup processes.
- SCCs & Data Transfer Addendum (redacted template) confirming Standard Contractual Clauses for EU data transfers.

A few clarifications for the DPIA questions you called out:
- Pseudonymization: for workloads that require it, we recommend tokenization at ingestion. We do not apply irreversible anonymization by default.
- Data minimization: customers control what they send. We offer prompt redaction helpers and client-side SDK filters.
- Subprocessors: the CSV provided by Aditya is current; we will include dates for onboarding in the final bundle.
